ci: Required set (rulesets): lint, typecheck, test, pr-title. CI head 5e1d0c16 (run 41149496883) still queued; head a22fdd7c has 0 check runs; GitHub reports the pull request mergeable_state dirty (conflicts with main 8fd342e4).

keyFindings.description: An approval moves to accepting only when GitHub's merge state is clean/unstable/has_hooks, but the reviewer always approves its own handoff head, which carries skip-checks: true and runs no workflow. On a base with required checks (sjawhar/legion: lint, typecheck, test, pr-title) GitHub reports such a head blocked (GitHub docs, 'Skipping workflow runs'; head a22fdd7c has 0 check runs). Every approval stays in reviewing for good, and round{} tells nobody. Needs the architect's decision (the spec's 'a head with no checks is CLEAN' holds only on a base that requires none).

Deletes every pending auto_merge_disable row and nothing disarms an auto-merge the old daemon armed; spec Rollout says the migrated merger's task tells it to turn off any such auto-merge. Four open pull requests are armed by the implement App today (sjawhar/legion#2321, #2295, #2176, theorem-labs/agent-infra#1040). A later head move then merges unreviewed code.
The head conflicts with main 8fd342e4 (12 files changed on both sides, from #2576 among others); GitHub runs no CI on it and the CI run of code head 5e1d0c16 is still queued. Merge main forward.

The recorded merge state and mergeability are not tied to a head: advance moves HeadSHA and keeps both, and PullRequestMergeability carries no head, so an approval can move on a state GitHub gave for an older head.
R5: a running merger told the gate closed reads 'Your phase goes on'; neither merger prompt says to merge nothing and dequeue (spec R5 asks for dequeuePullRequest).
turnOpen stays true after a death inside a turn (LastTurnEnd is written only at a normal end), so later deaths of the idle relaunched agent are charged and the claim fails.
R4: after ISSUE_CHANGED the retry writes again without the observed-status fence status() applies at line 465, so a person's in-workflow change made after the read is written over.

The legion tool still describes READY, its refusals and MANUAL_MERGE_REQUIRED (also handoff-commit.ts:22, pi-legion/AGENTS.md:474-492); api/handoff.go keeps Ready and READY_ROLE_FORBIDDEN and contracts still requires ready. The plugin ships with this contract bump, so cut it now.
Operator-visible strings promise the deleted two-minute pass: legion state's webhook-App line and intake/consume.go:257's warn line.

Docs still describe the two-minute pass, awaiting_merge and checksVerdict/fixAttempts (running-legion.md, troubleshooting.md, concepts.md), plus design-gate.md:5 ready-refused, AGENTS.md:156 'a merge the daemon submits', prompts/go/reviewer.md:11, release-bump.sh:18, ci.yaml/docs-pages.yaml path filters of deleted packages.
The approval carry exists twice (per-issue read and outbox row) under different event ids, with a duplicated implementClient and a comment claiming they share a memo they do not.
